blocks.prompt: 9 (a) Find permutation of 10 people sitting on a bench if: There are no restriction.
blocks.explanation:
10 alag log 10 seaton wale bench par baithne hain aur koi shart nahi.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: saare 10 log rakhne hain, is liye seedha \(10!\).
Socho bench par 10 jagahein hain aur 10 dost. Pehli jagah par koi bhi 10 mein se, doosri par baqi 9 mein se, aur aage isi tarah. Yahi \(10!\) hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 10 log, 10 seatein, koi shart nahi.
Humein find karna hai: kitne tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Saari \(n\) cheezein tarteeb se: \({}^{10}P_{10} = 10!\).
Kyun: "No restriction" ka matlab hai koi pabandi nahi, to seedha saari cheezon ka factorial. Har shakhs alag hai, is liye har tarteeb alag ginni hai.

\(10!\) nikaalein
\[10! = 10 \cdot 9 \cdot 8!\]
\[= 90 \times 40320 = 3628800\]
Kyun: \(8! = 40320\) humein Sawal 7(b) se pata hai. Bas \(10 \times 9 = 90\) se multiply kiya. Pehle se maloom factorial ko istemal karna waqt bachata hai.

Tasdeeq
\[10! = 10 \times 9! = 10 \times 362880\]
\[= 3628800 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(9! = 362880\) se bhi wohi jawab aata hai.
Dhyan dein: \(10!\) jaisa bara number yaad rakhna mushkil hai; \(8!\), \(9!\) se aage barhna behtar hai. Commas laga kar likhein: 3,628,800, taake digits ginne mein ghalti na ho.

blocks.prompt: 9 (b) Find permutation of 10 people sitting on a bench if: 3 cannot sit next to each other.
blocks.explanation:
Teen khaas log ek saath (teeno saath saath) nahi baith sakte.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: kul tareeqe \(-\) woh tareeqe jin mein yeh 3 saath baithe hain. "Saath" ginne ke liye teeno ko ek block (gathri) bana dete hain.
Socho teen bhai hain jo saath baithein to shor machate hain, is liye ustad kehta hai ke yeh teeno ek saath nahi baithenge. Baqi koi pabandi nahi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 10 log; 3 khaas log teeno ek saath na baithein.
Humein find karna hai: kitne tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Saath nahi = kul \(-\) saath. "Saath" ke liye block method: teeno ko rassi se baandh kar ek shakhs maan lo.
Note: Kitab (Example 6 aur answer key) is shart ko isi tarah parhti hai.

Kul tareeqe
\[10! = 3628800\]
Kyun: Part (a) se.
Dhyan dein: Kul tareeqe hamesha pehle likh lein; "saath nahi" wale har sawal mein yeh pehla qadam hai.

Teeno saath baithein
\[\text{Units} = 1 + 7 = 8\]
\[\text{Tareeqe} = 8! \times 3!\]
\[= 40320 \times 6 = 241920\]
Kyun: Block ek unit aur baqi 7 log, kul 8 units, jo \(8!\) tareeqon se baith sakte hain. Lekin block ke andar bhi teeno aapas mein jagah badal sakte hain, \(3!\) tareeqon se.
Dhyan dein: Block ke andar wala \(3!\) bhoolna sab se aam ghalti hai.

Minus karein
\[10! - 8! \times 3!\]
\[= 3628800 - 241920\]
\[= 3386880\]
Kyun: Kul mein se "saath" wale nikaal diye, to woh bache jin mein teeno ek saath nahi.
Dhyan dein: Kabhi kabhi students \(10! - 8!\) likh dete hain aur andar ka \(3!\) bhool jate hain; jawab ghalat ho jata hai.

Alfaaz ka doosra matlab
Agar matlab yeh ho ke in 3 mein se koi do bhi saath na baithein, to pehle baqi 7 ko bithao (\(7!\)); un ke beech aur kinaron par 8 khaali jagahein (gaps) banti hain, aur 3 log 3 alag gaps mein \({}^{8}P_{3}\) tareeqon se:
\[7! \times {}^{8}P_{3} = 5040 \times 336\]
\[= 1693440\]
Kyun: Answer key pehla matlab leti hai (3,386,880), is liye imtihan mein wohi jawab likhein, jab tak sawal mein saaf "no two" na likha ho.
Dhyan dein: Imtihan mein sawal ke alfaaz dhyan se parhein. "All three not together" aur "no two together" alag sawal hain aur un ke jawab bhi alag.

Chhoti misaal se tasdeeq
4 log (A, B, C, D), teen A, B, C ek saath na hon:
\[4! - 2! \times 3! = 24 - 12 = 12\]
24 tarteebon mein se theek 12 mein A, B, C saath saath hain, to 12 mein nahi \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Itni chhoti misaal hath se gin sakte hain, aur formula wohi jawab deta hai.
blocks.final_answer:
3,386,880 tareeqe
Yaani teeno ek saath na baithein to 3,386,880 tareeqe.
